{
  "decision-serialize-confirmed-specimen-labels": "WITH agreed AS (
  SELECT specimen, MIN(label) AS label, MIN(source_id) AS source_id
  FROM label_slip
  WHERE label IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY specimen COLLATE BINARY
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT label COLLATE BINARY) = 1
)
SELECT 'specimen,label,source_id' || char(10) || COALESCE(group_concat(record, ''), '') AS csv_text
FROM (
  SELECT '"' || replace(specimen, '"', '""') || '","' || replace(label, '"', '""') || '","' || replace(source_id, '"', '""') || '"' || char(10) AS record
  FROM agreed
  ORDER BY specimen COLLATE BINARY
);",
  "decision-settle-capped-royalty-and-advance": "WITH earned AS (
  SELECT license_id, opening_advance_cents, minimum_cash_cents,
         MIN(royalty_cap_cents, MIN(sales_cents, 10000) / 10 + MAX(sales_cents - 10000, 0) / 5) AS capped_royalty_cents
  FROM license_quarter
), recovered AS (
  SELECT earned.*, MIN(opening_advance_cents, capped_royalty_cents) AS recouped_cents
  FROM earned
)
SELECT license_id, capped_royalty_cents, recouped_cents,
       MAX(capped_royalty_cents - recouped_cents, minimum_cash_cents) AS cash_due_cents,
       opening_advance_cents - recouped_cents AS closing_advance_cents
FROM recovered
ORDER BY license_id;",
  "decision-settle-monthly-solar-export-credit": "WITH charges AS (
  SELECT b.bill_month, b.imported_kwh * t.buy_cents AS import_cents,
         b.exported_kwh * t.sell_cents AS export_cents, t.fixed_cents, t.source_id
  FROM bill_meter AS b
  JOIN tariff_notice AS t ON t.effective_month = (
    SELECT MAX(n.effective_month)
    FROM tariff_notice AS n
    WHERE n.effective_month <= b.bill_month
  )
), credits AS (
  SELECT charges.*, MIN(import_cents, export_cents) AS applied_credit_cents
  FROM charges
)
SELECT bill_month, import_cents, applied_credit_cents,
       import_cents - applied_credit_cents + fixed_cents AS due_cents, source_id
FROM credits
ORDER BY bill_month;",
  "decision-seven-day-repeat-contact-cohort": "WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT ticket_code, queue_code, contact_day,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ticket_code ORDER BY contact_day, contact_seq) AS contact_rank
  FROM ticket_contacts
  WHERE ticket_code IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT i.queue_code AS intake_queue,
       SUM(EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM ticket_contacts AS c
         WHERE c.ticket_code = i.ticket_code
           AND c.contact_day BETWEEN i.contact_day + 1 AND i.contact_day + 7
       )) AS repeat_tickets,
       COUNT(*) AS eligible_tickets
FROM ranked AS i
WHERE i.contact_rank = 1 AND i.contact_day + 7 <= 20
GROUP BY i.queue_code
ORDER BY intake_queue;"
}
